content: If all values from a vertical forget gate INLINEFORM0 were to be 0, this would mean that the introduction of the additional forget gate is meaningless and the model would reduce to a plain stacked LSTM. On the contrary if all values were 1, meaning that the vertical forget gates were always open, it would be impossible to say that the information is modulated effectively.
